bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 71
printf 'TARGET_SHA='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'USERBOT_ACTIVE='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'USERBOT_ENABLED='; systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'FILES_STATUS_BEGIN\n'
git status --short -- scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_room_smoke.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py
printf 'FILES_STATUS_END\n'
printf 'COMPOSE_FILES='; find deploy -maxdepth 2 -name '*compose*.yaml' -type f | wc -l
printf 'GAYBBS_CONTAINERS='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -c 'gaybbs' || true
printf 'USERBOT_SECRET_EXISTS='; test -f deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'RECIPIENT_SECRET_EXISTS='; test -f deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'BOTH_STAGED='; docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugdual-0f3633f >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'USERBOT_IPC='; test -S deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'DIAG_DONE\n'
